ok_change_explanation: All of these are states valid under the frozen convention that become unavailable under the correction, on three sessions (2025-06-03, 2025-10-29, 2025-11-24). On those days the 30-day target falls on a half-day expiry date. With the 13:00 instant that expiry drops below 30 days in the afternoon, and the next expiry needed to bracket it was not acquired, because contract selection used the frozen 16:00 convention.
